Even though the patterns of those mutations are well explored in many tumors, the dynamical process of clonal selection is underexposed. METHODS We studied the dynamics of clonal competition in a BcrAbl-induced leukemia using a γ-retroviral vector library encoding the oncogene in conjunction with genetic barcodes. To this end, we studied the growth dynamics of transduced cells on the clonal level both in vitro and in vivo in transplanted mice.
